title: 发言稿的对象与结构
goal: 根据听众选择发言表达，并区分开头、主体和结束语的作用。

points.label: 选择适合听众的发言表达
识别发言稿各部分的作用

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分的课题范围、知识点与教学规格

cards.title: 结构
rows: 向听众致意
开头向在场的听众问好，不写信件的称呼。
Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the first meeting of our student theater group.
说明主题
说明这次发言讲什么。只有欢迎语还不够。
Today I would like to explain how new members can contribute to our theater production.
分述要点
每一部分都围绕主题。转到下一点时，写出具体内容。
First, the stage team needs members to prepare simple props for the opening scene.
结束致谢
回到主题，感谢听众，不用信件的署名结尾。
Thank you for listening to this introduction to the work of our theater group.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 面向群体
everyone 称呼全体听众，不用单个人的称呼。
Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining this introduction to our music society.
建立共同语境
As new students 点出听众的共同身份，听众都是新生时才用。
As new students, many of us are still learning where to find academic support.
说明范围
focus on 说明这次只讲哪一部分。
My introduction will focus on the activities available during the society's first month.
转向要点
Another way to take part 引出另一种参加方式。
Another way to take part is to help prepare the room before each rehearsal.
结束回应
结尾回到本次主题，不再提新的事项。
I hope this introduction has clarified the different ways to join our theater activities.
信件与发言
信件用署名结尾，现场发言用口头的结束语。
Letter: Best regards, Chen. / Speech: Thank you for listening.

body.box:
Good morning, new students, and welcome to our college. My name is An, and I am a second-year student. Today I would like to introduce two sources of support that helped me settle into college life.

The first is the study advice center. Its staff can explain how to plan independent work and where to find course information. During my first term, a short appointment helped me organize several overlapping deadlines. The second is the student societies office. It provides information about groups with different interests, so joining an activity does not depend on already knowing a member.

Starting college involves many unfamiliar decisions, but asking a specific question can make a practical difference. I hope these two starting points help make the first weeks more manageable. Thank you for listening, and welcome again to our college.

body.p: 开头点明听众是新生，再说明主题是两种支持资源。主体分别介绍 study advice center 和 student societies office。末段回到适应大学生活的主题，没有加入私人请求。

body.box:
Good afternoon, everyone. I am pleased to introduce our campus repair afternoon, which will take place in the student center on Saturday. The activity brings together students who want to learn simple ways of caring for everyday belongings.

There will be two areas. At the clothing table, volunteers will demonstrate how to replace a loose button and close a small tear. At the stationery table, students can learn to replace notebook covers and organize unused paper. These are demonstrations for beginners, so no previous experience is needed. Materials for practice will be available at both tables.

The purpose is to share useful skills through careful practice, not to promise that every damaged object can be repaired. Anyone interested can speak to the volunteers after this introduction. Thank you for listening, and I hope the afternoon offers a useful opportunity to learn together.

body.p: 活动介绍先写活动、时间和地点，再介绍两个区域和参加条件。末段说明不是所有物品都能修好。两篇范文都面向一群听众，开头和结尾不能换成 Dear An 和 Best regards, An。

body.box:
Which opening fits the repair afternoon introduction?
1. Dear Volunteer, I am writing to request a private repair appointment.
2. Good afternoon, everyone. Today I will introduce our campus repair afternoon.
3. Dear Student Center, Thank you for replying to my repair application.
4. Good afternoon, volunteers. Thank you for attending my completed repair session.

body.p: 第二项面向在场的所有人，并点出要介绍的活动。第一、第三项是私人书信，第四项把还没举行的活动写成了已经结束。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 私人信件开头
Dear An, I am writing about college support.
这是面向全体新生的发言，不是写给 An 的信。
只致意不点题
Good morning, everyone. Welcome to the college.
有了致意，还没有说出要介绍的主题。
例子代替主体范围
The advice appointment concerned my deadlines.
这只是一个例子，概括不了两类支持资源。
结尾新增事项
Now I will introduce an unrelated travel scheme.
结尾回到当前主题，不引入无关的事项。
署名代替致谢
Best regards, An
这是书信的结尾。发言要向现场听众致谢。

groups.text: A student representative addresses all graduating students at a farewell gathering and introduces the evening's shared activities.

items.stem: Which opening matches the audience and occasion?
options: Dear Graduate, I am replying to your private invitation to tonight's farewell gathering.
Good evening, new applicants. I will explain our admission activities.
Dear Representative, Thank you for arranging my private farewell meeting.
Good evening, fellow graduates. I will introduce tonight's farewell activities.
items.why: all graduating students 对应 fellow graduates，introduces the evening's shared activities 对应介绍当晚的活动，即第四项。

groups.text: A student welcomes visitors to an open studio, then explains how the demonstration spaces are arranged.

items.stem: What is the function of the explanation after the welcome?
options: To welcome the visitors a second time before the studio opens.
To develop the announced topic with practical information.
To thank the visitors after the studio demonstrations have ended.
To state the topic of the talk before the visitors are welcomed.
items.why: explains how the demonstration spaces are arranged 给出参观需要的具体信息，是欢迎之后的主体部分，即第二项。

groups.text: A speaker finishes explaining a campus walking tour to a group waiting at its starting point.

items.stem: Which closing fits the spoken introduction?
options: Thank you for listening. I hope the tour makes our campus more familiar.
Best regards, the tour organizer, in reply to your personal message.
Dear Tour Visitor, I am writing about a possible campus route.
Thank you for completing the tour before arriving at its starting point.
items.why: finishes explaining 说明介绍已经讲完，group waiting at its starting point 说明游览还没开始。第一项用口头致谢结束，与此相符。

groups.text: A talk about student exhibitions introduces the venue, explains entry arrangements, and ends by thanking the audience.

items.stem: Which sentence belongs in the main explanation of entry arrangements?
options: Thank you for listening to this short introduction to the student exhibition.
Good morning, everyone, and welcome to this briefing on the student exhibition.
Visitors can collect an entry card at the exhibition room entrance.
I am pleased to introduce our student exhibition to everyone here.
items.why: explains entry arrangements 属于主体。第三项说明在哪里领取入场卡，是入场安排。第四项是点题的句子。

groups.text: Good afternoon, members of the photography society. Today I will introduce the portrait practice session. First, participants will observe how a volunteer positions a lamp. Next, small groups will try the arrangement and discuss the photographs. The purpose is to compare lighting choices, so a simple camera is sufficient. Thank you for listening.

items.stem: Which statement explains the role of the final sentence?
options: It announces the lighting comparison as a new topic.
It requests a private reply from a society member.
It thanks the group after completing the introduction.
It gives the practical sequence for taking photographs.
items.why: Thank you for listening 出现在活动步骤和目的之后，作用是结束致谢，即第三项。

items.stem: Complete a spoken opening addressed to the society members.
items.why: to welcome everyone here 面向在场的全体成员，to our portrait practice session 点明共同的活动。

groups.text: A senior student is speaking to visiting exchange students at a welcome meeting. The talk introduces the peer-support program, explains how students can request a partner, and ends with thanks. Partners help newcomers find campus services; they do not choose courses for them. Applications can be discussed with the program team after the talk.

items.stem: Which opening fits the actual listeners and purpose?
options: Dear Partner, I am writing to ask you to choose my courses.
Welcome, program staff. I will explain how to recruit exchange students.
Welcome, exchange students. I will introduce our peer-support program.
Dear Senior Student, Thank you for approving my partner application.
items.why: speaking to visiting exchange students 和 introduces the peer-support program 确定了听众和主题。第三项两点都对。

items.stem: Which sentence belongs in the body rather than the opening or thanks?
options: Good morning, exchange students, and welcome to the meeting.
I am pleased to introduce today's peer-support program to all of you.
Thank you for listening to this introduction to student support.
The program team can discuss partner applications after this talk.
items.why: Applications can be discussed with the program team after the talk 是申请安排，属于主体，即第四项。

items.stem: Complete a welcome addressed to the exchange students at the meeting.
items.why: to welcome our visiting exchange students 点明现场听众，to this meeting 点明场合。

items.stem: Complete the sentence introducing the talk's practical content.
items.why: how 引出这次要讲的内容，can apply for a partner 对应申请伙伴的办法。

groups.text: At a meeting of residence-hall students, a speaker introduces a board-game evening. The body explains that beginners will learn the rules at separate tables before joining a short game. The event is intended to help residents meet each other. The speech should close after explaining participation, without asking for a personal written reply.

items.stem: Which closing fits the audience and the spoken occasion?
options: Thank you for listening. I hope the evening helps residents get acquainted.
Best regards, the organizer. Please reply to my personal letter about games.
Dear Beginner, Thank you for sending a private account of the evening.
Thank you for listening. I will now read the personal replies from residents.
items.why: The speech should close ... without asking for a personal written reply 要求用口头致谢结束。meet each other 是活动目的，第一项的结尾回应了这个目的。

items.stem: Which sequence gives the talk a clear structure?
options: Describe a finished game, thank residents, introduce the evening, greet listeners.
Greet residents, introduce the evening, explain participation, thank listeners.
Thank residents, request private letters, introduce the evening, explain rules.
Introduce the evening, end with thanks, greet residents, explain participation.
items.why: 发言先向听众致意、点明活动，再说明怎样参加，最后致谢，即第二项。

items.stem: Complete a spoken thank-you to the residence-hall audience.
items.why: for listening to this introduction 是现场发言的结束语，our board-game evening 回到本次活动。

items.stem: Complete the sentence linking the body to the activity's purpose.
items.lead: The aim of the evening is
items.why: to help residents get to know one another 说明活动的目的是让住户互相认识。
